description: BaNaY(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.68 Å) and three longer (2.83 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are three shorter (2.84 Å) and six longer (2.87 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.27 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Y, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ba, one Y, and one B atom.
